reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/publ: every caller is a public client action handler passing ctx.match.row, the one client action row enterClientAction found by the SHA-256 of the token the holder posted (current or prior hash); the org is that row's own org_id and every statement names that row's id
reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/deci: link path: the org of the row findByTokenHash found by the posted token's hash (pre.org_id); portal path: the portal session's own org (T17's caller passes the session org and the action id is re-read under it); the transaction then re-reads that one action by id in that org
reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/mint: called by the public request route with the org of the client action row found by the posted token's hash (row.org_id, row.id), and by the kernel's own mint path with the minted action's org; the action is re-read by id AND org_id before anything is sent

reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/targ: the org of the client action row the caller read (by its token hash, or by id inside the caller's own org); the app's read tool runs as that action's sender
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/mint: the org of the one action remailClientAction re-read by id AND org_id (reviewed outside-route entry above); the link mail, the failed-send rotation and the sender lookup it calls all name that action
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/mail: every caller (the link, code and copy mail of this module) passes the org of the one client action being mailed: the row found by the posted token's hash, or the action the kernel just minted or re-read by id AND org_id
